description: BASE 9825aba. Root cause of recurring PLAN_INVALID FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT on delegated opens (live: OBJ_dda4ac80 json_transfer planner attempts): (1) the canonical planner prompt never listed eligible cross-mission artifacts — the model guessed input names from goal text and picked the output name exports/journal-export.json instead of real sibling journal.html; (2) the delegated-open edge (planExpander→invokePlannerPool) passed externalInputArtifacts=undefined for initial planning, so the pool canonicalizer could not bind ANY cross-mission consume — 'modify existing file' was unplannable on the delegated path. Fix: (a) artifact-handoff gains listEligibleExternalInputSourcesForWorkItem — the SAME canonical sibling scope resolved before a consumer Mission/WOB exists (0 allocations → []; malformed → fail closed); (b) planExpander resolves it from expandCtx.work_item_id → pool canonicalizer + planFn; (c) buildPlannerUserPrompt/codexPlannerPlan render a bounded EXTERNAL INPUT ARTIFACTS block (logical name + provenance) with the rule that consumes name only an earlier in-plan producer or a listed artifact — never a desired output; UNBOUND rejection guidance points at the listed set. Authority unchanged: prompt is context only; pool stamps are re-proven byte-for-byte at mission commit; absent expandCtx → identical prior behavior. Tests: W1-W4 eligibility scope; E1-E5 prompt contract + codex parity.
